blurb: Tourism Abbotsford highlights the rich heritage of Abbotsford through museums, historic sites, and exhibitions. It offers information on outdoor adventures including hiking, biking, and dog-friendly activities. Visitor services include a mobile Explorer Trailer and a visitor kiosk at the airport with maps, guides, and local advice.
extraNote: Visitor kiosk at Abbotsford International Airport, 30440 Liberator Ave, Abbotsford, BC, V2T 6H5
